question: India finished on which of the following positions in overall medals tally at Commonwealth games 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India finished in the 4th position in the overall medals tally at the Commonwealth Games 2022.
 
• India secured a total of 61 medals in the competition.
 
• Out of these, India won 22 gold medals, 16 silver medals, and 23 bronze medals.
 
• The performance was remarkable considering the tough competition from other participating nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonwealth Games**

 
 
• The Commonwealth Games is an international multi-sport event involving athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• The event was first held in 1930 and has been conducted every four years since then, except for 1942 and 1946 due to World War II.
 
• The games are overseen by the Commonwealth Games Federation (CGF), which also controls the sporting program and selects the host cities.
 
• The Commonwealth Games feature sports that are popular in the Commonwealth countries, including athletics, swimming, rugby sevens, and netball.
 
 
 
• **India's Performance in Commonwealth Games**
 
 
• India has been participating in the Commonwealth Games since 1934.
 
• India's best performance came in the 2010 Commonwealth Games held in Delhi, where it finished second in the overall medals tally.
 
• India has consistently performed well in sports like shooting, wrestling, weightlifting, and boxing in the Commonwealth Games.
 
• The 2022 Commonwealth Games saw India achieving significant success in various disciplines, showcasing the country's sporting talent and determination.
 
 
 
• **Medals Tally**
 
 
• The medals tally is a table that lists the number of gold, silver, and bronze medals won by each country participating in a multi-sport event.
 
• The ranking in the medals tally is usually determined by the number of gold medals won, followed by the number of silver and bronze medals.
 
• In the event of a tie, the total number of medals won is considered.
 
• The medals tally provides an overall picture of the performance of countries in the event and highlights the leading sports nations.
